Verdict: not fixed
Checked: malformed authority and malformed escape sequence inputs under the same absolute-target invariant.
Evidence: both reach the same unguarded `new URL` call in `targetBoundary.ts:24`, which can throw instead of returning a controlled decision. This is one root cause with two triggers.

shellCommands: node -e "for (const value of ['https://[', 'https://x/%zz']) { try { new URL(value); console.log('ok') } catch { console.log('throws') } }"
